summary_en: Tender offer correction filing. TCG2511 Co. (ALSOK co-acquirer) acquiring Japan Drychem ordinary shares at ¥4,150/share. Offer commenced 14 May 2026. Correction relates to withdrawal conditions following FTC approval of non-imposition of exclusionary measures (4 June 2026) and shortened prohibition period notice.
title_en: (Correction) Notice of Correction Relating to Correction Amendment to Public Tender Offer Filing for Ordinary Shares of Japan Drychem Co., Ltd. (Code: 1909) by TCG2511 Co.
translation_en_brief:
This is a correction notice filed on 6 June 2026 by TCG2511 Co. in relation to a tender offer for ordinary shares of Japan Drychem Co., Ltd. (TSE Standard market, code 1909). The tender offer was initiated on 14 May 2026 at ¥4,150 per share, with ALSOK Co., Ltd. named as a joint acquirer.

The correction was necessitated after ALSOK (identified as a special related party of TCG2511) received a notification from the Japan Fair Trade Commission on 4 June 2026 stating that the FTC would not issue an exclusionary measure order, and a separate notice on the same date regarding shortening of the prohibition period. These FTC determinations required amendments to the tender offer filing, specifically to the withdrawal conditions (撤回等の条件) previously disclosed.

The document specifies that the correction does not alter the tender offer terms (買付条件等) as defined in the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act Section 27-3(2)(1), and that amended versions of the 13 May 2026 announcement and the tender offer commencement notice are being filed and attached.
